title: Salah (Shelah)
summary: Son of Arphaxad (Gen 11:12); father of Eber.
description: Masoretic text: born AM 1693 (when his father was the age given in Gen 11), lived 433 years, died AM 2126. No CFAH paper dates this person; the sort year falls to Ussher.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 2311 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
birth.note: The 15th ed. (2002) Chronological Compendium prints this AM and no BC year. That entry is kept. This BC year is the 23rd ed. Appendix F figure.

birth.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), "Chronological Compendium", p. 1 ("Salah born when Arphaxad was 35 ... 1693")
Gen 11:10–26 (Arphaxad AM 1658 = Shem's 100th year, two years after the Flood of AM 1656; each later birth adds the father's age at the named son)
Ussher, Annals of the World, Second Age §45 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 2)," Biblical Chronology 6:4 (April 1994), §8 "The Chronology of Genesis 11" (year list)
Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 2, chart "Genesis 11:10 – 12 Genealogy"
birth.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 1693.

birth.date: "Sala ... whom Arphaxad had for his son at the hundred and thirty-fifth year of his age"
birth.note: Josephus (Whiston) has 135, the Septuagint-type figure; the Masoretic text has 35 (Gen 11:12).

birth.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 782a
birth.note: Year cell "2376 1694 37". The third printed figure 37 is the column "Floud", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 433 at the end of the name is the lifespan he prints. His table also prints the death at World 2126. 1694 + 433 is not 2126. Both figures are left as printed.

birth.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxii
birth.note: The parenthesis is the Hebrew age. The other age is the one he adopts. The last figure is his B.C. column.

death.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002). Leave empty until verified.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Third Age §88 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

death.note: Stated relative to Abraham; Jordan prints no AM figure for this death.

death.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 2, chart "Genesis 11:10 – 12 Genealogy"

death.note: Year cell "2808 2126 43". The third printed figure 43 is the column "Promise", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682.
